task.summary: 默认任务

refactor(system): 合并授权服务到系统服务并调整配置
- 删除 eagle-authorization-server 模块相关代码和配置 - 将授权服务器配置迁移到 eagle-system-server 模块中 - 修改系统服务监听端口为 8081，统一端口管理 - 调整系统模块依赖，新增 spring-boot-starter-oauth2-authorization-server 依赖 - 从 docker-compose 文件中移除授权服务相关内容 - 删除授权服务 Dockerfile，移除无用文件 - 修改包路径，将授权服务相关代码合并并重命名至系统服务中 - 在公共模块中新增单元测试依赖，补充测试覆盖 - 优化主项目 build.gradle 文件，添加 JVM 参数支持重新定义删除方法

refactor(deps): 将starter模块依赖范围由implementation改为api
- eagle-common-starter模块所有依赖改为api范围，便于传递给使用者 - eagle-data-jpa-starter模块中project和spring依赖改为api范围 - eagle-resource-server-starter模块将主要依赖改为api范围，新增oauth2-resource-server依赖 - build.gradle中添加lombok-mapstruct-binding和mapstruct-processor注解处理器 - 添加EagleDataJpaStarterApplication类作者注释 - settings.gradle中移除include路径前多余的冒号，使路径标准化

refactor(common): 重构聚合根相关类及调整实体继承关系
- 删除 AggregateRoot 接口，改用 AbstractAggregateRoot 作为聚合根基类 - 将 BaseAggregate 类重命名为 BaseAggregateRoot 并继承 AbstractAggregateRoot - 省略了多余的领域事件管理代码，精简聚合根实现 - 多个领域模型实体类（如 Dict、User）继承 BaseAggregateRoot，统一聚合根设计 - 修正各实体类中的基础类导入路径，移除冗余导入 - UserProfile 值对象中调整构造函数注解，保持 JPA 兼容性

refactor(common): rename BaseDomainEvent to BaseEvent and update references
- 将 BaseDomainEvent 重命名为 BaseEvent，统一领域事件基类命名 - 更新 BaseAggregateRoot 中的事件列表类型为 BaseEvent - 修改用户领域事件继承自 BaseEvent - 修整 UserService 中领域事件发布逻辑，移除重复事件手动发布 - 调整 UserMapper 的 MapStruct 配置，忽略未映射目标属性 - 删除 SecurityConfig 中的宽松 CORS 配置，简化安全配置 - 添加 eagle-feign-starter 模块的空依赖块和测试示例代码填写 - 新增项目说明文档 CLAUDE.md，介绍项目架构和开发规范

chore(config): 更新本地数据库连接和依赖配置
- 修改 application-local.yml 中 H2 数据库文件路径 - eagle-system-server 模块引入 thymeleaf 启动器依赖 - 优化主构建文件依赖管理，调整 Lombok 和 MapStruct 配置 - 增加 Spring Boot 开发工具依赖，增强开发体验 - SecurityConfig 中新增 JWT 签名密钥生成的 Bean 方法，解决启动重置问题 - eagle-common-starter 模块调整 BaseAggregateRoot 类，移除领域事件列表改用 JPA 主键注解 - 移除 User 实体中仅供 JPA 和 MapStruct 使用的 setter 方法，简化代码 - eagle-doc 中补充统一响应格式设计决策说明，说明现阶段不需要统一包装响应结果，避免过度设计

fix(service): 修复用户注册和用户服务设置问题
- 注释掉RegisterApplicationService中设置用户名的代码，避免空用户名保存 - 注释掉UserService中设置用户Profile的代码，防止错误的Profile赋值 - 保持其他用户信息的正常保存和部门设置逻辑不变

feat(system): 重构系统模块引入领域驱动设计和新功能模块
- 将密码加密器BcryptPasswordEncryptor重命名并移至config包 - 引入Guava库依赖 - 重构DTO和控制器包结构，统一迁移至web模块下 - 新增基于WebSocket的ChatController实现消息广播与私信功能 - 部门、字典、字典项模块引入充血模型设计，聚合根实现业务方法 - 新增部门和字典领域应用服务，提供增删改查及激活停用能力 - 新增部门、字典和字典项控制器支持相关REST接口 - 添加部门、字典及字典项DTO请求和响应类，含验证注解 - 字典项支持树形结构查询，业务层完成树形构造逻辑 - 完善日志及异常处理策略，提升系统稳定性和可维护性

refactor(service): 删除 UserService 服务，精简代码结构
- 移除 UserService 类及其相关方法 - 删除用户管理的应用服务逻辑 - 精简代码库，去除不再使用的服务层组件 - 保留包声明文件便于模块划分和管理

refactor(system): 清理冗余代码并优化映射器配置
- 删除 ChatController 和 LoginController 等冗余 REST 控制器 - 移除 UserRestController，简化用户管理模块接口 - UserDomainService 中注释禁用角色分配及移除功能调用 - EventHandler 中删除新增用户密码加密实现 - 为 DictItemMapper、MenuMapper、UserMapper 添加映射器未映射目标忽略策略 - 为 DictItemMapper 添加批量转换方法以支持列表转换

- Implement Account entity with fields: username, password, phone, locked status, and WechatBinding - Provide factory methods for creating Account via username/password, Wechat MiniProgram, phone, Wechat Web, and Wechat H5 - Implement JPA @PostPersist callback to publish AccountRegisteredEvent after insert with complete ID and profile hints - Add domain events AccountRegisteredEvent and AccountDeletedEvent for cross-domain integration - Implement methods for password change, phone binding, account lock/unlock, and various Wechat bindings - Define database indexes on username

- Add .gitignore with IDE, build, OS, and security-related exclusions - Introduce RESTful API interface specification and coding style guides - Add exception handling and Feign remote call standards - Define module boundary governance for Spring Modulith usage - Add AdminProperties and JwtKeyProperties configuration classes with validation - Provide default application.yml and application-local.yml configurations - Configure

删除无用文件

feat(auth): implement complete account management and authentication module
- Add Account aggregate root to manage user credentials and account status - Implement factory methods to create accounts via username, phone, and WeChat bindings - Add domain events AccountRegisteredEvent and AccountDeletedEvent for async integration - Develop AccountApplicationService for full account lifecycle handling with transactions - Add password change, phone binding, account lock/unlock and deletion features - Implement SMS-based password reset and phone binding verification with rate limiting - Create AccountController REST endpoints for registration, password reset, binding, locking - Introduce AdminInitializer to auto-create admin account on application startup - Add configuration properties classes for admin and Aliyun SMS service setups - Implement AliyunSmsServiceImpl for sending and verifying SMS codes with caching and limits - Define AccountRepository interface with queries by username, phone, and multiple WeChat IDs - Add Address value object as embeddable JPA component for future user profile enhancement

refactor(build): centralize group, version, and Nexus publishing config
- Remove group and version declarations in eagle-bom/build.gradle to unify under root allprojects block - Set group and version in root build.gradle allprojects block for consistent project metadata - Add centralized Nexus repository publishing configuration for all subprojects - Configure publishing credentials from project properties or environment variables - Exclude eagle-bom module from java plugin due to java

refactor(build): improve Gradle dependency constraints and publications
- Replace 'api' with explicit 'add('api', ...)' calls in eagle-bom dependency constraints to avoid IDE DSL warnings - Use 'register' method instead of named blocks for MavenPublication in publishing to enhance IDE signature recognition - Simplify GraalVM native binaries configuration with 'binaries.named' and 'set' method for javaLauncher - Import java.time.Duration for cleaner timeout setting syntax in build.gradle - Add comprehensive Gradle publishing and usage documentation in eagle-doc for local, Nexus, and Maven Central deployments - Document consumption scenarios including BOM-only usage and multi-service version consistency guidance

feat(lock): add distributed lock abstraction and Redis implementation
- Define DistributedLock interface with tryLock methods supporting wait and lease times - Provide default lock acquisition parameters and convenient overloads - Add LockProperties for configurable lock types, granularity, and MQ-related settings - Introduce LockAutoConfiguration to enable distributed lock configuration properties - Create LockErrorCode enum for common lock-related error codes and messages - Implement RedisDistributedLock using Redisson with tryLock logic and error handling - Add RedissonAtomicUtil component for atomic counters with typical usage examples - Provide RedisAutoConfiguration to register RedisDistributedLock bean conditionally - Add example gradle.properties for Nexus repository and credentials settings - Configure build.gradle with multi-module publishing, JVM toolchain, and dependency management

feat(rocketmq): implement RocketMQ-based distributed lock and token initializer
- Add LockTokenInitializer to send initial lock tokens to MQ topics on startup - Implement RocketMqDistributedLock using RocketMQ SimpleConsumer for distributed locking - Provide MQ lock token automatic initialization configurable via properties - Add RocketMqAutoConfiguration to wire domain event publishers and distributed lock beans - Support per-key and shared-topic locking granularity modes - Handle lock acquisition by exclusive token message consumption with automatic recovery - Log initialization details and error handling for better observability

docs(security): add detailed security guidelines for OAuth2 and token management
- Define authentication framework with gateway centralized authentication and JWT validation by resource server starter - Prohibit manual token parsing in business services; enforce use of JWT Decoder - Specify Access Token and Refresh Token default lifetimes and revocation through Redis - Enforce password encryption with BCrypt, deny insecure storage and exposure of credentials - Require explicit @PreAuthorize on all controllers with multi-tenant support via tenant starter - Outline sensitive data masking using custom annotations instead of manual substring - List input security risks and corresponding defenses including SQL injection, XSS, SSRF, CSRF - Mandate CORS configuration restrictions for production environments - Standardize security response headers injected by gateway - Demand audit logging for sensitive

- Introduce naming conventions aligned with Google Java Style Guide and DDD layering - Define detailed code style rules including formatting, comments, and Lombok usage - Establish DDD-based layering architecture for modular monolith and microservices - Specify module boundary governance using Spring Modulith annotations and tests - Provide RESTful API design standards including resource naming and security - Add database best practices focusing on entity design, indexing, and CQRS queries - Lay out standardized exception handling with unified error codes and exception types - Outline concurrency control with transaction management and event handling requirements - Set unit testing conventions emphasizing structure, naming, coverage, and mocking rules
